description: This file defines the EmployeeSkillDao class, which provides data access methods for EmployeeSkill-related database operations within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching employee skills, as well as managing available skills for employees.

classes.name: EmployeeSkillDao
classes.description: A data access object (DAO) class providing CRUD and search operations for EmployeeSkill entities in the database.

methods.name: saveEmployeeSkill
methods.description: Persists an EmployeeSkill entity to the database.

methods.name: getEmployeeSkillById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific EmployeeSkill by employee number and skill ID.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeSkills
methods.description: Deletes multiple EmployeeSkill records based on employee number and a list of skill IDs.

methods.name: searchEmployeeSkill
methods.description: Performs a search for EmployeeSkill records based on provided filter parameters, returning matching entities.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeSkillPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a paginator object for EmployeeSkill search results based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeSkillsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of EmployeeSkill records matching the search filter.

methods.name: getEmployeeAllowedSkills
methods.description: Retrieves a list of skills that the employee is allowed to select, based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeAllowedSkillsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of skills that the employee is allowed to select.

methods.name: getEmployeeAllowedSkillsPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a paginator object for the list of skills the employee is allowed to select.
